title: 2026 空間資訊脈絡 動態採樣技術 工作營
title_en: 2026 Spatial Context Engineering Workshop: Dynamic Sampling Techniques
excerpt: 兩天半密集實作：從零組裝 ESP32-S3 微控制器，捕捉空間中的光線變化、人流與身體動作，經 Wi-Fi 轉譯為結構化數據流，驅動馬達與燈光完成「動態採樣 → 空間互動回饋」的虛實整合原型。教育部教學實踐研究計畫核心實作活動，現場配發開發套件，不需任何電路或程式基礎。
excerpt_en: A two-and-a-half-day intensive: assemble an ESP32-S3 microcontroller from scratch, capture light, presence and body movement in real space, stream it over Wi-Fi as structured data, and drive motors and lights to complete a cyber-physical prototype from dynamic sampling to spatial feedback. Core hands-on activity of a MOE Teaching Practice Research project; development kits provided, no electronics or coding background required.
location: 淡江大學建築學系系館 K102（電腦教室）
location_en: Room K102 (computer classroom), Department of Architecture Building, Tamkang University
